content: Official page-sizes guide: apps targeting API 35+ must support 16KB pages on 64-bit; from 2027-02-01 updates without 16KB support cannot be released. NDK r28+ aligns by default; r27 and lower need -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 and common-page-size. AGP 8.5.1+ zip-aligns uncompressed libs. Check with zipalign -c -P 16 and llvm-readelf LOAD align 2**14; RELRO end alignment also matters.
